defect_confirmed: The runtime workflow ran a generic 'doctor' + 'test e2e' and recorded a packet that did not identify WHICH artifact was certified.
implementation: candidate manifest schema CARLA_CANDIDATE_RELEASE_MANIFEST/v1 with 12 required identity fields
validate_candidate_manifest() pre-runtime gate: existence, schema, every required field, repo SHA vs checked-out SHA, XODR path+hash, CARLA build identity
any mismatch is a hard FAIL; the workflow stops before contacting a server
workflow resolves the checked-out SHA with 'git rev-parse HEAD' and binds the manifest to it
receipt records candidate SHA, XODR, cook/package hashes, CARLA client+server version, UE build, runner class, workflow run ID and timestamps
receipt state is PASS only when the identity gate passed AND the job succeeded; IDENTITY_MISMATCH/FAIL otherwise
workflow resolves the named runtime-certification-gate so the runtime verdict is explicit
partial_status_note: The identity contract, pre-runtime gate, workflow binding and receipt are implemented and tested. The live runtime execution itself is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL because no CARLA 0.9.16 self-hosted runtime is reachable from this environment.

remaining_blockers.detail: No live CARLA 0.9.16 server or self-hosted [carla] runner is available in this environment. World load, ego spawn, surface validity, waypoint-graph correspondence and navigation were NOT executed.
exact_action_required: Provide a candidate manifest (CARLA_CANDIDATE_RELEASE_MANIFEST/v1) on a machine with a self-hosted CARLA runner
gh workflow run carla-runtime.yml -f candidate_manifest=<path> -f expected_carla_version=0.9.16
Confirm the uploaded receipt at reports/runtime_certification/receipt.json reports state=PASS

reuse_existing_schemas: No competing manifest authority was invented: the gate extends the existing repo_health owner and the existing map registry / file_hashing helpers.
title: Exact-artifact CARLA runtime certification
